overview: Instruction bits ko opcode, register, address fields me baantna; expanding opcode se max instructions.
coreConcept: Total bits = opcode + operand fields. Expanding opcode me unused opcode patterns ko next level ki instructions ke liye reuse karte hain.
hinglishExplanation: Instruction length fix ho to fields ka sum = length. Expanding opcode me pehle level ke unused codes ko aage expand karo: free = total - used; next level = free x 2^(extra bits).
formalDefinition: Total bits = opcode + operand fields. Expanding opcode me unused opcode patterns ko next level ki instructions ke liye reuse karte hain.
importantProperties: Instruction bits = opcode + register fields + address/immediate.
Expanding opcode: free opcodes x 2^k next level.
Byte-addressable memory me address bits = log2(memory size).
